messages:
Olivia: Quick RFC follow-up — proposing we carve out the tenant-homing + routing decision logic into a small 'homing-service' before we touch the session mesh. Goal: reduce cross-service churn and give teams a single safety kill-switch for routing changes.

Jamal: +1. What's the minimum surface for that service? can it be a thin proxy with a stable proto?

Olivia: minimal surface = input: (tenant_id, request_meta) -> output: {route, capacity_tier, fallback_model}. Keep versioned proto + idempotent evaluation. No stateful sessions in homing-service.

Sophia: Concern: latency on hotpath. If we add an extra RPC we need p95 < 2ms. Can we inline a local cache and shadow requests?

Olivia: Yes — plan is: 1) start as local sidecar in a canary cohort w/ in-process cache; 2) enable outbound RPC to central homing-service in staging; 3) promote to running mode when we see stable latencies. Shadowing first.

Andrew: Rollout/rollback question — prefer feature-flags that can toggle routing path per-tenant. Also we need metrics for correctness (route churn, mismatch rate).

Olivia: Agreed. Proposed flag: homing.extract.mode = [disabled, sidecar-shadow, rpc-canonical]. Per-tenant override allowed. We will emit metric homing.route.delta (bool) for shadow vs canonical.

Mel: Operational ops: add a safety circuit that will automatically fall back to existing router if homing.route.delta > 0.01 for 5m or latency spike > 10%. That buys us automatic rollback.

Jamal: Can we get an OSS-friendly compatibility shim so existing consumers can import proto but not depend on runtime libs? Keep migration simple.

Olivia: Yes, we'll publish a minimal client in internal package 'homing-client' with a tiny HTTP/gRPC shim and a strict compatibility test suite.

Sophia: Integration test checklist idea: (1) deterministic inputs -> expected route; (2) chaos: spike latency on homing-service and ensure auto-fallback; (3) canary traffic shaping.

infra-bot: Deploy plan created: homing-extract-spike-2026-03 — staging rollout -> canary 5% -> 25% -> 100% with automated rollback hooks. See runbook link: https://runbook.internal/homing-extract-spike

Andrew: Can someone own the 'metrics contract'? I can take it but need a small spec for ingestion shape (counter + gauge names).

Olivia: Assigned to Andrew. I'll add a short spec to the RFC doc today: metric names, thresholds, and dashboard panels.

Mel: Quick note: make sure dedicated/dedicated-private modes keep a mode where homing-decisions are local-only for data isolation.

Olivia: Good call. Add mode 'local-only' to the flag set. We'll validate via a dedicated-mode test matrix.

Jamal: Sounds actionable. I'll start a spike branch to extract the proto and client.

Olivia: Thanks — I'll follow up with the RFC patch and a rollback test matrix. :thumbsup:

Sophia: 👍
